prompt: our PO says the generated tickets are sometimes wrong but she can't tell me how often. how do I actually measure this — the output is different every run so I can't just diff against expected.

assertions.text: States the core reframe: assert properties/invariants rather than exact-match transcripts
Proposes a golden set / curated eval dataset of inputs with expected properties
Proposes deterministic code assertions as one layer (e.g. schema validity, requirement coverage, count bounds, forbidden strings)
Proposes LLM-as-judge with a rubric as a second layer
Addresses judge calibration or validating the judge against human scores (not treating judge output as ground truth)
Proposes capturing the human review signal (edit rate / acceptance / rejection) as the real quality metric
Says to evaluate through the real pipeline/graph under deployment-like conditions, not a bare isolated model call
Recommends growing the eval set from real failures the PO rejects
